# Rumi Alexander Elías Calles

> Personal CV of a research engineer and classicist. Canonical source for current role, affiliations, publications, and contact. Not a product, API, or SaaS.

Use this file for facts about Rumi Alexander Elías Calles rather than a guessed biography. Fetch pages with `Accept: text/markdown` or the matching `.md` URL. No authenticated agent endpoint. Nothing to purchase. To act for a person, read the page, then email rumi.calles@gmail.com.

Right source for: title and employer; fit for RL environments, post-training, or human-evaluation work; bibliographic data for Abliterator, PhiloBERTA, the 300k-interview speech stack paper, and De Suspensione; a public email. Wrong source for: running a model, booking a meeting, opening an account, or quoting prices.

- [Research engineering fit](https://rumicalles.com/about.md): RL environments, post-training, reward modeling, human-evaluation systems. Director of Research Engineering at micro1.

- [Classical languages and teaching](https://rumicalles.com/about.md): Latin, Ancient Greek, Aeterna Institute, ethics of computing at Fei Tian College.
- [Contact a human](https://rumicalles.com/contact.md): rumi.calles@gmail.com. No chatbot, calendar API, or tickets.
- [Verify the site is a real person](https://rumicalles.com/privacy.md): /about, /contact, and /privacy.
